title: RWB-S9-E6035-APP: the contracted fee schedule has no table, column, rate, tier, basis or rounding in any source, the legacy data table carries no payment or recovery entity, the plan's C row is empty while four rows are consumed, DP-04, DP-06, DP-07, DP-10 and DP-16 are absent from the pattern set, TSD S9 T8 maps every requirement row away from FEAT-PRM-07, the two service events carry no fee, and no message is published for a payment that matches no placement or a date with no schedule row
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.3 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S9-E6035-APP; context pack S9 rwb-partner (service row, ownership rows, decoupling table, Architecture v5 slides 2, 4, 5, 8 and 12); legacy RWB-E6-035; FSD S9 Partner management v3 A1.1, A1.3, A2.7 and its four sub-sections, A2.2, Requirements served and Screens; TSD S9 Partner management v2 T2, T3.0, T3.1, T3.2, T3.3, T5.1, T5.2, T5.3, T6.1, T6.2, T8 and T-A; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-WO-33 and R-WO-37; Recovery Workbench Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 row FEAT-PRM-07
description: (1) The step works out the fee due from the contracted fee schedule, yet no source publishes one: TSD S9 T3.1 lists partner and partner_instruction only, with fee_amount (DF-PRT-016) as a result and no rate, tier, basis or rounding; FSD S9 A2.7 omits A2.7.3.2 (the field catalog) altogether; FEAT-PRM-02 promises the panel and fee schedule as versioned reference data without saying where they live or what they hold; and the ownership rows give S9 three tables, none of them a schedule. (2) The money side has no entity either: the legacy Data table names recovery_case, partner, decision_log_entry and rule_row and no payment, and FSD S9 A2.7.2 names ALS and GL with FEAT-PAY-01 as its prerequisite, so the matched money arrives from another owner and the payment reference, amount and value date carry no field ID, format or operation name. (3) No rule row expresses the fee: the module publishes VR-S9-007-1 and BR-S9-007 only, and the fee lives in R-WO-37, a Write-off route row owned by rwb-writeoff, so the package version can be recorded but no rule ID can be attributed to the calculation. (4) TSD S9 T8 maps REQ-S9-001 to 004 and 008 to FEAT-PRM-01 and REQ-S9-005 to 007 and 009 to FEAT-PRM-08, so REQ-S9-004, whose text names the contracted fee schedule, is attributed to another feature and no requirement row traces to FEAT-PRM-07. (5) The plan's C row is empty while the step consumes rwb-payment, rwb-case for the case, rwb-case for the reference data and rwb-decision, and the pattern set holds DP03, DP13 and DP19 only, so DP-04, DP-06, DP-07, DP-10 and DP-16 are real dependencies with no row. (6) TSD S9 T5.3 names two published events (EV-20 and EV-21, InstructionIssued and PartnerResultSubmitted in the context pack's two event rows) and no consumed event; the pairing of ID to name is not published, and no event carries a fee or the match to rwb-reporting. (7) TSD S9 T5.2 gives P4 for access and reference data while the default ruling and DP-07 give parameters and reference data to rwb-case (P3). (8) No message is published for a payment that matches no placement (X3) or for a date with no schedule row (X4), and the legacy message set holds MSG-GEN-001, MSG-P4-002 and MSG-P7-003 while the module rule adds MSG-P1-001.
evidence: TSD S9 T3.1 (partner DF-PRT-001 to 007, partner_instruction DF-PRT-008 to 016, fee_amount as numeric(18,2) and no schedule table); TSD S9 T3.2 (four lists, none for a fee basis); TSD S9 T3.3 (two relationships, both to case_id and partner_id); TSD S9 T5.2 (P3 case, P7 decision log, P4 access and reference data, P5 documents, P6 notices); TSD S9 T5.3 (InstructionIssued and PartnerResultSubmitted, both published); TSD S9 T8 (every REQ-S9 row mapped to FEAT-PRM-01, FEAT-PRM-08 or a placeholder); TSD S9 T-A.2 (API-S9-001 and API-S9-003 with errors 401, 403 and 503, no fee property); FSD S9 A2.7.2 (integration points ALS and GL, Partner portal; prerequisite FEAT-PAY-01), A2.7.3.1 (VR-S9-007-1 and BR-S9-007) and Requirements served (REQ-S9-004); Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 row R-WO-37 (condition the payment matches the case and the placement, action calculate the agency fee, to state PAYMENT_MATCHED, owner Workbench, systems ALS core and GL and Agent Runtime, timer next working day); legacy RWB-E6-035 Data and Endpoints; context pack ownership rows (3 tables, 6 operations, 2 events, 0 jobs, 1 workflow)
area: Business rule and reference data; data ownership; dependency classes; event catalogue; requirement traceability; message set
owner_role: Business lead; reference-data owner in rwb-case; solution architect; owner of rwb-payment
proposed: Confirm the contracted fee schedule as versioned reference data of rwb-case with its columns, rate basis, tiers, rounding and effective dates before wave 4 starts; confirm the operation and the fact shape of the posted payment of rwb-payment and add the C rows for the four consumed contracts; add the pattern rows DP-04, DP-06, DP-07, DP-10 and DP-16 or record their absence; decide whether the fee is announced on an event of the service; publish the messages for a payment that matches no placement and for a date with no schedule row; and add the requirement row that traces to FEAT-PRM-07 at the next version of TSD S9 T8 and in the E6 BRD and the S9 PRD.

title: RWB-S9-E6035-CON: the Partner and PartnerInstruction elements carry no fee property and no source publishes their names, formats or value sets, no source publishes the contracted fee schedule, the four consumed operation names have no published baseline, no requirement row traces to FEAT-PRM-07, and the plan's C row is empty while the baseline declares four consumed rows
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.2 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S9-E6035-CON; context pack S9 rwb-partner; legacy RWB-E6-035; FSD S9 Partner management v3 A2.7.2, A2.7.3, Requirements served and Features (FEAT-PRM-02, FEAT-PRM-07, FEAT-PRM-09); TSD S9 Partner management v2 T2, T3.1, T3.2, T3.3, T5.2, T5.3, T6.1, T8, T-A.1 and T-A.2; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 row R-WO-37
description: (1) TSD S9 T-A.2 publishes the request and answer shapes of API-S9-001 and API-S9-003 with their errors, but no property for the matched recovery, the recovered amount or the fee due, and no message ID per condition on the two reads. (2) No source publishes the names, the formats or the value sets of the three fee properties: FSD S9 A2.7 has no field catalog (A2.7.3.2 is absent), TSD S9 T3.1 lists partner and partner_instruction fields without a fee property of the answer, and TSD S9 T3.2 publishes no list for one. (3) No source publishes the contracted fee schedule the element would draw on: no table, no column, no rate, no tier, no basis and no rounding, although FEAT-PRM-02 promises it as versioned reference data. (4) No source publishes the operation names of the posted-payment read of rwb-payment, the case read and the reference-data read of rwb-case or the package read of rwb-decision, and the context pack carries the service row and the ownership rows without a connection matrix for S9. (5) TSD S9 T8 maps every REQ-S9 row to FEAT-PRM-01, FEAT-PRM-08 or a placeholder, so the baseline has no requirement row to trace to and the legacy story carries no REQ id. (6) The plan's C row is None while the baseline declares four consumed rows, and DP-04, DP-06, DP-07, DP-10 and DP-16 are absent from the pattern set. (7) TSD S9 T5.2 gives P4 for access and reference data while the default ruling and DP-07 give them to rwb-case (P3). (8) TSD S9 T5.3 names the two published events without pairing EV-20 and EV-21 to their names, and no event carries the fee.
evidence: TSD S9 T-A.1 (six operations, API-S9-001 and API-S9-003 read with the Partner portal right R); TSD S9 T-A.2 (query type and status, query status, page and size, answers Partner[] and InstructionPage, errors 401, 403 and 503, idempotency not applicable); TSD S9 T3.1 (seven partner fields and nine instruction fields, fee_amount numeric(18,2)); TSD S9 T3.2 (LOV-PARTNER-TYPE, LOV-PANEL, LOV-INSTRUCTION, LOV-INSTR-STATUS, no fee list); TSD S9 T3.3 (partner_instruction to recovery_case and to partner); TSD S9 T5.2; TSD S9 T5.3; TSD S9 T6.1 (29 identities with the Partner portal column); TSD S9 T8; FSD S9 A2.7.2, A2.7.3.1, Features and Requirements served; legacy RWB-E6-035 Endpoints (two reads), Data and Permission checks (eight roles and 21 more); Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 row R-WO-37
area: Contract surface; element properties; reference data; dependency classes; requirement traceability
owner_role: Business lead; solution architect; tech lead of rwb-partner; owners of rwb-payment, rwb-case and rwb-decision
proposed: Publish the three fee properties of the instruction answer with their names, formats and value sets as an additive change of major version 1; publish the contracted fee schedule as a documented reference-data contract of rwb-case with its columns, rate basis, tiers, rounding and effective dates; publish the operation names of the four consumed rows; add the C rows for the four contracts and the pattern rows DP-04, DP-06, DP-07, DP-10 and DP-16 or record their absence; pair EV-20 and EV-21 with their names in the event catalogue; and add the requirement row that traces to FEAT-PRM-07 at the next version of TSD S9 T8 and in the E6 BRD and the S9 PRD.
